items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I saw him later, a year before he died, and he said, 'Son, how you been?'

ctx.x: Benny Carter's father was there. I saw Benny Carter's father cut a man's ear from here to here. You know? The guy had hit him, and he came down and he cut that man. But don't say it... I saw him later, a year before he died, and he said, 'Son, how you been?' He didn't even know that I... Because the man, you could see his teeth. And we walked all the way to Russo Hospital here from 63rd Street to (?), hollering at him... And he stayed there the rest of his life, down on 11th Avenue, just hanging out...
Who did? The man or Benny's father?
